about_the_game:
Test yourself on the neon lit tracks of Neon Runner. Swerve, jump, and boost your way to the finish line in this vapourwave/outrun inspired runner. This fast paced runner style game requires speed and precision to complete all levels as quickly as possible to set a high score.



  • 13 procedurally generated levels
  • Bright, vibrant neon, Vaporwave/Outrun style graphics
  • Synthwave soundtrack
  • High score leader board
